Photo 1 shows a Toyota-style front grille with a central badge; the grille has vertical slats and chrome surround.

claims.claim: Prado Jeep front grill and tailight in working condition available in GRA Ikeja.
claims.evidence: Photos show a front grille (photo 1) and headlamp assemblies (photo 0), but no tail light is shown; location (GRA Ikeja) is not verifiable from photos.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy.
claims.evidence: No Toyota part number/markings/label visible in the photos to confirm originality (photos 0-1).

claims.claim: No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: Lenses look intact in the provided angles (photo 0), and some mounting tabs/brackets appear present, but completeness of all clips/brackets and absence of hairline cracks cannot be confirmed from these photos alone.
No powered-on test, no bulb/LED function check, and no wiring/connector condition shown (photos 0-1).

risks.risk: Tail light claim mismatch: photos show headlamps and a grille, not a tail light.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the actual tail light (rear lamp) from multiple angles, including the lens and mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as grille + headlamp assemblies only (tail light not included / not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Exact Toyota Prado variant/year fitment unknown (different generations have different lamp/grille shapes).
risks.proof: Ask for the vehicle year/model and a photo of the part number label/stamp (or the VIN/plate of the donor car) and a close-up of any markings on the grille/lamp housings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used Prado-compatible parts with fitment risk (assume may need minor adjustments).

risks.risk: Original vs China copy cannot be confirmed from photos.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of Toyota markings/part numbers on the grille and lamp housings (and any OEM sticker/engraving).
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-OEM/unknown quality used parts.

risks.risk: Electrical working condition not proven (headlamp function could be dead/weak, fogging, or internal damage).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video powering the lamps (low/high beam and indicators if applicable) showing both sides working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (assume needs testing/possible replacement of bulbs/LEDs).

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or lens clouding not visible in the provided angles.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up macro shots of the lens edges and corners (front and back) plus a flashlight scan across the lens.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may have minor defects (no guarantee of perfect condition).

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the tail light (rear lamp) if it’s truly included—multiple angles and the mounting side.
Provide close-up photos of any Toyota/OEM part numbers or markings on the grille and lamp housings.
Send a short video showing the lamps powered on (low/high and any indicator/DRL functions visible).
Confirm the Prado year/variant the parts came from, and share fitment proof (e.g., donor car details or part number match).
response.reason: The photos clearly show a front grille and headlamp assemblies, but the seller claims a tail light and “working condition.” Tail light inclusion and electrical working status cannot be verified remotely, so pricing safely requires the missing proof.
